I can do that — but this will be a destructive calendar change, so I need a few clarifying details and an explicit confirmation before I proceed.

Please confirm the following (or tell me how you want each handled):

1. Which calendar(s)?
   - My default: your primary calendar. If you want a specific calendar name or multiple calendars, say so.

2. Date range for "next week"
   - I assume you mean Monday–Sunday of the upcoming week: July 13–19, 2026. Confirm or give exact start/end dates.

3. What counts as a "meeting"?
   - Common options:
     a) Any event that has one or more other attendees (i.e., has guests) — recommended.
     b) Any event marked Busy (regardless of attendees).
